description: Main Garden: Entry from roadside via new courtyard enclosed by existing garage to left, a new red brick wall to north and a low cedar fence to east, the red brick wall to have bespoke oak door to centre. Existing ceramic tiles to be replaced with York stone and Chelmer Valley Winton red clay brick pavers. A re-routed entrance path in Chelmer Valley Winton red clay pavers and associated planting for privacy and dividing garden into two sections. A timber bike shed store and bin store to left of entrance path to be situated behind existing garage and accessed via new York stone path. West Courtyard: A new York stone paving surface to link in with rest of the garden/property and a new widened freestanding oak pergola framing the space and allowing further planting. Rear Courtyard: Existing York stone retained and re-pointed along with addition of x3 timber tree planters and a ground level trampoline. Kitchen / Rear Courtyard: A new raised terrace linking kitchen to garden to be surfaced with existing York stone while surrounding raised beds to be constructed from red bricks matching house. Remaining surfaces are all York stone (reusing existing material). Overhead, a freestanding oak pergola frames  raised terrace and extends beyond the terrace to provide for an oak swing bench. To rear of the raised terrace is a set of faux French doors with a mirrored window, the doors being a replica of existing kitchen doors. Boundary wall on eastern and northern sides to have a freestanding cedar fence in front, set to same height as wall.***WITHDRAWN***
